Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed on a monthly bases as 
indicated by M1 in the
titled block
The Traveling water screen system is used for cleaning of the Nile River water 
utilized for the operation of the combined cycle power station from plastics, 
wood .... etc
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abd El Azeem, tested by eng. Mohamed Fawzy Agwa at 13 July 2004, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Abouda Elbanna, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed El Sarrag, 
approved by eng Moneer Mahmoud Al Wakeel; Damietta power station head sector, and certified by eng. Aly Al Lethy: 
EDEPCo inspection and quality control head sector.
Manufacturer / Type | Magrini Galileo Italy / U-33300
Design flow | 154.8 m3/h
No. of filtering panels | 37
Screen mesh clear opening | 5mm
Panels travel speed (slow / fast) | (1.5 / 3) m/min
Motor power | 1.3 KW
Safety Precautions
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the screen mechanically and electrically.
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the screen mechanically and electrically.
Tools and Equipment
Maintenance tool set.
Grease (multi purpose grease).
Wires to raise up the screen cover.
